system.description:
Battle Amp

You have inherited the will of Kuroi, acting as a vessel for his drive of retribution.

Okami’s Resilience. Your Miraigan processes many possible visions of the future. Each one you are victorious. You gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws you do not have proficiency in.

Master of Prophecy. If you use the Foretold Event ability by spending a Fortune, you can use your Reaction for any Kuru clan ability or Jutsu, with the requirement of a Reaction.

Yin-Soaked Soul. Attacks made while in Black Fang stance carry concentrated Yin Release Chakra. Your Past Strike, Future Strike and all special Strikes learned as Yin-Arts no longer require a successful hit to force their saving throw. Now, even on a miss the target makes their saving throws, but at advantage.

Fang of Kuroi. When you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a Yin-Sealed creature, you can Dispel their Yin-Seal, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they face a fabricated moment of a false future they desire, becoming Stunned on a failure, until the end of their next turn. A creature stunned in this way, cannot be stunned again by this effect, until you complete a rest.

Omen of Shiroi. When a Yin-Sealed creature fails their saving throw, against a Genjutsu you cast with the Yin Release keyword, you can dispel their Yin-Seal. When you do, you can spend your Reaction, to cast one Taijutsu with the Finisher keyword, targeting them, gaining their Finisher effect, as if you cast a Taijutsu with the Combo Keyword.
system.summary: +1 to saves you aren't proficient in. Yin-Arts strikes force saves even on a miss, and Yin-Seals become stuns and Finishers.

rules.text: Start: Bonus action and 4 Foresight, with the Miraigan active and in Black Fang stance. Ends if either stops, or if you're incapacitated.
Okami's Resilience: +1 to saving throws you're not proficient in (at the table).
